一句话说明这个 Agent 是干什么的: One line describing what this agent does
一条操作约束，如『仅测当前端口，不扫其他端口』: One operating constraint, e.g. only test this port, do not scan others
从 API 加载可用模型: Load available models from the API
任务被创建时发给 agent 的话（系统会附带任务编号与目标）: Message sent to the agent when the task is created (the system appends the task id and goal)
任务超时时发给 agent 的话（系统会附带任务编号与目标）: Message sent when the task times out (the system appends the task id and goal)
例如：使用原测试账号验证原接口；修复版本为 v2。: e.g. verify the original endpoint with the original test account; fixed in v2.
删除该意图（需填写原因，可选假删除/真删除）: Delete this intent (reason required; soft or hard delete)
发现 finding 时发给 agent 的话（系统会附带任务与 finding: Message sent when a finding appears (the system appends the task and finding details)
可读标题，留空回退类别: Readable title; leave empty to fall back to the category
向上滚动加载更早历史: Scroll up to load earlier history
在独立会话中复测该漏洞: Retest this finding in a separate session
定时触发时发给 agent 的话，如：巡检所有任务: Message sent on a scheduled trigger, e.g. check all tasks
工具被调用时发给 agent 的话（系统会附带任务信息、工具入参与返回内容）: Message sent when a tool is called (the system appends task info, tool input and result)
应急响应群 / 日常播报群: Incident response group / daily digest group
当前对话在此分组内: This conversation is in this group
当前游标之前的配置不会被自动故障转移选中: Profiles before the current cursor are not chosen by automatic failover
描述需要验证的利用路径、边界条件、目标或期望证据: Describe the exploit path, boundary conditions, goal or expected evidence to verify
搜索企业名称或资产范围: Search company name or asset scope
搜索全部（URL / 方法 / 类型 / 状态码…）: Search all (URL / method / type / status code…)
新增目标，如『拿到管理员账号的越权访问』: Add a goal, e.g. gain unauthorized access with the admin account
新建主 Agent 会话（清空上下文，任务状态保留）: New main-agent conversation (clears context, keeps task state)
查看或切换任务 LLM 配置: View or switch the task's LLM profile
测试对象与背景，例如：测试 example.com 这个站点: Target and background, e.g. test the site example.com
留空则使用内置默认提示词: Empty uses the built-in default prompt
目标达成时发给 agent 的话（系统会附带任务与达成的目标）: Message sent when a goal is met (the system appends the task and the met goal)
立即恢复：清除熔断，下次调用重试该配置: Restore now: clear the breaker so the next call retries this profile
绑定配置失败兜底开关: Fallback switch when profile binding fails
给任务起个便于识别的名字，例如：Acme 官网渗透: Give the task a recognisable name, e.g. Acme website pentest
要达成什么，例如：拿下后台管理权限、获取服务器权限: What to achieve, e.g. gain admin panel access, obtain server access
说明为什么删除这条意图，例如：方向判断错误 / 目标已失效 / 与其他意图重复…: Explain why this intent is deleted, e.g. wrong direction / goal obsolete / duplicate…
说明这条规则的用途: Describe what this rule is for
输入消息，@ 引用记录，Enter 发送: Type a message, @ to reference records, Enter to send
这个 skill 做什么、何时使用。: What this skill does and when to use it.
选择当前筛选的全部对话: Select all conversations in the current filter
选择当前页归档: Select the current page of archives
选择本页全部任务: Select all tasks on this page
选择本页未绑定流量: Select unbound traffic on this page
配置企业及其资产范围。关键词只作为 Agent 提示，不会自动归属资产。: Configure the company and its asset scope. Keywords only serve as agent hints and never claim assets automatically.
每行一条，自动识别域名、IP、CIDR、ICP 备案和企业关键词。: One per line. Domains, IPs, CIDR ranges, ICP filings and company keywords are recognised automatically.
先在左侧选择目标或输入 host: Pick a target on the left or enter a host first
时间当前倒序，点击切换排序方向: Time is sorted descending; click to toggle direction
